name: Rank & File
notes: 5 photos: two full menu-page photos (one plain, one Rank & File branded) plus two zoomed crops of the plain page are food menus; the 5th photo is the wine/cocktail/beer/seltzer drink list and was skipped. The plain and branded pages overlap heavily (Appetizers, Soups & Salads) with slightly different prices, apparently different menu print runs at this Sycuan restaurant - used the Rank & File-branded prices where they conflicted and merged in the unique Entrees/Burgers items from the other page.
